text: The following question stood in the name of Ms Mariam Jaafar – 21 To ask the Minister for National Development in light of recent closures of small retail and food and beverage (F&B) shops in the heartlands (a) whether the Government has assessed how these closures affect neighbourhood vibrancy, social cohesion, and long-term community resilience; and (b) what concrete measures are being taken to sustain local commercial diversity.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: When there are vacancies, HDB will assess the trade designation and tender them out as soon as possible.
